Sequence integrity checks for quality control

Source: R/qc.R
rb_qc_checks.Rd

Functions to check individual sequences or groups of sequences for common quality issues.

  • rb_check_codons(): Checks coding sequences (COI) for stop codons and frameshifts.

  • rb_check_rrna_integrity(): Checks rRNA sequences (12S, 16S) for abnormal length and the presence of any non-ACGT characters (including alignment gaps and ambiguous IUPAC codes like 'N').

  • rb_check_divergence(): Detects phylogenetically divergent sequences within species/gene groups using MAFFT alignment and FastTree.

Usage

rb_check_codons(sequence, gene, coding_genes = c("COI"), genetic_code = "2")

rb_check_rrna_integrity(
  sequence,
  gene,
  rrna_genes = c("12S", "16S"),
  min_length = 100
)

rb_check_divergence(
  data,
  species_col = "species",
  gene_col = "gene",
  sequence_col = "sequence",
  id_col = "unique_code",
  min_seqs = 5,
  outlier_mult = 5,
  outlier_floor = 0.02,
  mafft = "mafft",
  fasttree = "FastTree"
)

Arguments

sequence

A single DNA sequence string.

gene

The gene/marker type (e.g., "COI", "12S", "genome").

coding_genes

Gene types to check for codon issues. Default c("COI").

genetic_code

Genetic code table (default "2" for vertebrate mtDNA).

rrna_genes

Gene types to check for rRNA integrity.

min_length

Minimum expected length for rRNA sequences.

data

A data frame containing sequences and metadata.

species_col, gene_col, sequence_col, id_col

Column names.

min_seqs

Minimum sequences per group for divergence analysis.

outlier_mult

Multiplier for median edge length to find outliers.

outlier_floor

Minimum absolute edge length for outliers.

mafft, fasttree

Paths to external executables.

Value

  • rb_check_codons() returns a list with has_stop, frameshifted, best_frame.

  • rb_check_rrna_integrity() returns a list with has_short, has_gaps.

  • rb_check_divergence() returns data with a div_result column.

Details

Note: This function relies on shell pipes (|) to stream MAFFT output into FastTree. While this works on Unix-like systems, Windows users may need to ensure their shell environment (e.g., Git Bash or WSL) is properly configured, or install MSYS2, as the default cmd.exe may not support these pipes.

See also

Other quality control: rb_qc_pipeline, rb_qc_screening
